title: Co−Ln Mixed-Metal Phosphonate Grids and Cages as Molecular Magnetic Refrigerants

synthesis.procedure: All complexes were made from [CoII2(μ-OH2)(O2C tBu)4]·(HO2C tBu)4 (Co2) in autoclaves, generally in MeCN; crystals formed on cooling or on standing. In the absence of base, Co2, hydrated Gd nitrate, and tert-butylphosphonic acid give 1Gd (lower yield than heavier Ln analogues). The compounds can be recrystallized from dichloromethane. No numerical reagent amounts are given in the main text.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C, then cooled to room temperature at 0.05 °C min−1
synthesis.ph: mildly acidic; hydroxide still present because Ln ions can hydrolyze bound water even at pH 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals obtained directly from cooling the autoclave solution or from the filtrate; recrystallization from dichloromethane.
synthesis.yield: lower than for heavier Ln analogues of family 1

properties.summary: Family 1 Gd grid shows the largest magnetocaloric effect in the family. χT falls on cooling but remains paramagnetic at 2 K. −ΔSm = 21.4 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K and 7 T.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to 1Gd from Co2, hydrated Tb nitrate, and tert-butylphosphonic acid without added base in MeCN autoclaves. Heavier-Ln members of family 1 generally crystallize directly from the autoclave. Recrystallizable from dichloromethane. No numerical amounts in the main text.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C, then cooled to room temperature at 0.05 °C min−1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals typically obtained directly from the autoclave; recrystallization from dichloromethane.

properties.summary: Paramagnetic Co–Tb grid; χT decreases from 300 to 2 K and magnetization does not saturate at 7 T. No −ΔSm tabulated.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to other 1Ln grids from Co2, hydrated Dy nitrate, and tert-butylphosphonic acid without base in MeCN autoclaves; crystals generally form directly. Recrystallizable from dichloromethane. No numerical amounts in the main text.

properties.summary: Anisotropic Dy analogue of family 1 has a smaller MCE than 1Gd. Maximum −ΔSm is 11.6 J kg−1 K−1 (reported at 4 K in the text and at 3 K/7 T in Table 1), about half the Gd analogue.

properties.summary: Y analogue used to probe Co···Co coupling. Magnetization at 2 K/7 T reaches 11.0 μB, consistent with four uncoupled tetrahedral Co(II) ions and an antiferromagnetic, essentially diamagnetic central {Co4} square. −ΔSm is smaller than for 1Dy and 1Gd (4.5 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K/7 T).

synthesis.procedure: If dimetallic pivalate Gd2 is used in place of hydrated lanthanide nitrate in the same (no-base) reaction that gives 1Ln, [Co8Gd4(O3P tBu)6(O2C tBu)16] (2) is obtained. The reaction does not work for heavier lanthanides. No numerical amounts in the main text.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C, then cooled to room temperature at 0.05 °C min−1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals from autoclave reaction as for family 1.

properties.summary: Irregular [4 × 3] Co8Gd4 grid. −ΔSm = 21.1 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K and 7 T.

synthesis.procedure: Under the same no-base autoclave conditions used for 1Ln, replacing tert-butylphosphonic acid with benzylphosphonic acid gives family 3. For Gd, x = z = 0 and y = 2, i.e. two MeCN ligands and no extra pivalic acid or water in the stated formula. No numerical amounts in the main text.

synthesis.procedure: Benzylphosphonic acid analogue of family 3 with x = z = 0 and y = 2 (same formula type as 3Gd). Structure is of the more symmetrical 3Gd/3Tb type. No numerical amounts in the main text.

synthesis.procedure: Addition of base (Et3N, NaOMe, NaOEt, or KOH) to the Co2/Ln nitrate/tert-butylphosphonic acid reaction gives family 4. For Gd, x = 0 and y = 2. The reaction works in MeCN, DMF, and toluene. No numerical amounts in the main text.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C, then cooled to room temperature at 0.05 °C min−1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals from autoclave reactions in several solvents/bases.

properties.summary: Largest MCE among the reported families. Magnetization-derived −ΔSm reaches 28.6 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K and 7 T with no downturn yet. Heat capacity gives −ΔSm = 33 J kg−1 K−1 at 4 K for ΔB0 = 14 to 0 T, approaching the full available entropy 24.9 R = 47.6 J kg−1 K−1.

synthesis.procedure: Isolated for gadolinium by allowing the clear autoclave solution from the family 1 (no-base) reaction to stand at room temperature. Suggests this hexametallic cage forms for lighter lanthanides. No numerical amounts in the main text.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature standing after autoclave
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Clear autoclave solution stood at room temperature to give 5Gd crystals.

properties.summary: χT shows an upward turn at low T (possible ferromagnetic interactions). −ΔSm = 20.0 J kg−1 K−1 at 3 K and 7 T.

synthesis.procedure: Equivalent of 5Gd made for Nd, consistent with this hexametallic cage forming for lighter lanthanides. For Nd, crystals were generally found only after several days from the filtrate. No numerical amounts in the main text.

synthesis.time: several days for Nd crystallization from filtrate

synthesis.procedure: The gadolinium analogue of 6Nd can be made the same way: using dimetallic Ln pivalate under benzylphosphonic acid conditions, crystals grow from autoclave solutions after standing (weeks for Nd). No numerical amounts in the main text.
